normalized_unit: fraction of reference diagonal, NOT meters
hypotheses: Goal coverage misses and same-candidate path errors may coexist; compare corresponding heads without additive causal decomposition
First-softargmax candidate can differ from GT oracle; SelectionGap is not ranking-head failure
Motion amplitude and turning may associate with error; compare raw, diagonal-normalized and future-path-normalized descriptions
Recording heterogeneity may persist after descriptive motion stratification; not a causal residual
Semantic unreliability causing errors remains UNVERIFIED absent semantic ID, GT and segmentation-error evidence

metrics.GoalFDE: Euclidean sampled goal to GT final position
metrics.oracle: ADE/FDE/Goal independently argmin across20 heads; exact ties smallest original index
metrics.selection_gap: first full path error minus independently minimized full path error
metrics.goal_path_distance: same-head sampled goal minus same-head decoded final position
metrics.direction: angle between consecutive displacement vectors, both steps >=1 raw pixel; otherwise NaN
metrics.future_path_normalized_error: error/max(GT future cumulative path length,1 raw pixel); OFFLINE_ONLY

thresholds.large_step: max predicted step > max(50 pixels,4*max historical step); descriptive flag, not physical collision
thresholds.weak_history_direction: 0 or1 reliable displacement among7; all histories still have8 observed positions

groups.hist_speed: Low/medium/high using source TRAIN7496 diagonal-normalized mean-speed terciles; np.quantile linear; ties go to higher bin
groups.hist_motion_amplitude: Source TRAIN7496 diagonal-normalized history cumulative-path terciles
groups.future_amplitude: OFFLINE_POSTHOC: pooled998 diagonal-normalized future path terciles, linear quantile; no use in model or sampler

taxonomy.A: minGoalFDE20>10/25/50px, report all three; primary A25
taxonomy.B: ADE1>=25 and minADE20<=10 and ADE gap>=15 and relative ADE gap>=.5
taxonomy.C: At least one same candidate has GoalFDE<=10 and ADE>=25; also report closest-goal-only and terminal/middle subtypes
taxonomy.D: minADE20>=25 AND (history turning OR variable history speed OR weak reliable history direction); association only
taxonomy.E: Any predicted point outside reference OR large-step criterion; retain all outputs
taxonomy.overlap: Nonexclusive; report per-recording counts, pairwise intersections and exact combinations; never sum rates as partition

statistics.correlations: Spearman average ranks, finite pairs; pooled AND within recording; no p values
statistics.uncertainty: No window bootstrap, no significance claims, no cluster bootstrap with only5 recordings
statistics.sensitivity: Five leave-one-recording-out paired YNet-vs-CV/OLS comparisons; original full cohort always retained
statistics.motion_stratification: Report every recording x each hist-speed and future-amplitude bin including empty groups; no imputation
statistics.amplitude_standardization: Common pooled tercile weights only if all three bins exist in the recording; otherwise undefined
statistics.missing: Undefined numeric values are empty/NaN, never zero; preserve targets

cases.rule: Sort by category score ascending then sample_id; ranks floor(q*(n-1)), q=.25,.5,.75; deduplicate ranks, fill with first unused sorted ranks until min(3,n). No aesthetic reselection.
cases.view: Full reference view includes all coordinates; detail bounding box of history/GT/all20 paths/all20 goals/CV/OLS8 plus max(10% span,20px) margin
cases.overlays: Actual cached20 paths/goals; original history/GT; first path; ADE oracle OFFLINE_ONLY; CV-Last2 and OLS8 freshly calculated and checked vs frozen values

figures.curves: Only7 actual validation nodes; unsmoothed; no interpolated observations
figures.axes: Raw pixels and diagonal normalization separately labeled; marker counts and posthoc labels disclosed
figures.SVG: Remove trailing whitespace only after normalized XML equivalence assertion; no coordinate edits

outliers: All998 retained, all20 heads retained, no winsorization; geometry flags do not exclude targets
interpretation: This cohort selected the checkpoint and has repeated development exposure. Freeze analysis rules prospectively for this audit, not independent confirmation.
